name: Meadowstone Manor
positioning: Private luxury estate in Stowe, Vermont, rented as a whole home by Dripcastle Estate Collection, near Stowe Mountain and within view of Mt. Mansfield
best_for: Large groups and family reunions who want an entire private estate
Ski and mountain trips with a concierge to handle gear and plans

facts.text: The estate is near Stowe Mountain and within view of Mt. Mansfield.
The estate is surrounded by 30 private acres.
Hiking trails run across the 30 acres, and in winter guests can snowshoe, go tubing and cross-country ski on the property.
Stowe Mountain is less than 10 minutes away, and downtown Stowe, with restaurants and shopping, is five minutes away.
Each guest room has luxury linens and a private ensuite bathroom.
The design features panoramic windows and stone and wood detailing.
There is a private wellness studio with a dedicated spa treatment room, plus an on-site gym and fitness studio with a Peloton.
The estate has a home theater, a game room and an on-site pub with a billiards table.
The property has a fully equipped chef's kitchen.
There are fire pits and fireplaces throughout the estate.
Complimentary concierge services can arrange private chefs, massage therapists, wellness practitioners and tennis coaches at the property.
The estate is dog friendly; small and medium-sized dogs are generally welcome, confirmed in advance.

highlights.text: A spring-fed freshwater pond on the grounds has a floating dock.
The estate has a private heated pool and two hot tubs.
There are two clay tennis courts, a pickleball court and a basketball court.
Many rooms open onto private patios or balconies with views of the pool, the spring-fed pond or the surrounding Green Mountains.
The concierge can coordinate an in-home ski valet service to outfit the whole group with ski and snowboard gear.

considerations.text: Meadowstone Manor is booked as a full-property buyout and is not available for a single room rental.
Housekeeping is an add-on arranged through the concierge.
The nearest major airport, Burlington International, is about 45 minutes away by car.
